about: Reusable scenes for brief videos (announcements, promos, event and launch posts). Each card styles itself only from the pack's token contract, has slots with limits, a tier (takeover fills the frame; support sits over footage or another card) and a purpose. Compose them with formats/scripts/cards.py; place each on a beat, a word or a second (anchors).

cards.about: One statement, word by word from a mask; *word* is the accent

slots.name: text
slots.hint: 3 to 8 words; *focal* word in the accent; | breaks a line

cards.about: A number counts up over the accent rule, with what it measures

slots.name: source
slots.hint: where the number comes from (shown small)

cards.about: Two to four short points step in on the beat, each with the brand's motif as its marker
A quote rises line by line, the attribution follows

slots.name: quote
slots.hint: the exact words, from a source you can show

slots.name: by
slots.hint: who said it, and their role

cards.about: Name and role on an accent bar in the lower safe area, over footage or another card

slots.name: role
slots.hint: their role or a short line

cards.about: The logo lands, the tagline and an optional call to action follow on the accent line

slots.name: tagline
slots.hint: the line under the logo; | breaks it where you want

slots.name: cta
slots.hint: where to go: a date, a URL, a booth number
